meta.title: Sweyl Pro · Game preparation for coaching staffs
meta.description: Scouting, stats for both teams and video synced to every play. Coming soon, demo by appointment.

hero.title:
The game is
won *before*
the tip-off.
hero.sub: Your stats, theirs, the scouting and video synced to every play. The tool for coaching staffs, from regional to national level.

trio.title: The same scouting, *everywhere.*
trio.sub: Prepared at the desk, opened courtside. Every player reads their report on their phone.
trio.caption: Opponent player report, published to the team

scouting.title: Their game. *Your matchups.*
scouting.sub: Their plays, their defenses, their players, on a scouting report that grows season after season. You set the matchups, you publish: each of your players knows who they're guarding, and can study it at their own pace.

sheet.label: Scouting report
sheet.value: Style of play, defenses, plays, players

duels.label: Matchups
duels.value: One opponent, one or more of yours

publication.label: Publishing
publication.value: You know who read it, and when

opponents.title: Every opponent gets *their line.*
opponents.sub: Their numbers, their shots, their turnovers, entered on the same screen as yours. At the buzzer, you know who hurt you.

entry.label: Entry
entry.value: Player by player, jersey numbers from the game sheet

when.label: When
when.value: Live, after the fact or from the video

analysis.title: The game, *explained.*
analysis.sub: The runs, the droughts, the shooting of both teams. And every shot, right where it was taken.

flow.label: Game flow
flow.value: Runs and droughts, basket by basket

shooting.label: Shooting
shooting.value: Yours, theirs, against your usual numbers

video.title: Every play *replays* its *moment.*
video.sub: One click on a stat and the film jumps right to it. Enter stats from the video: every play is born in sync.

entry.label: Entry
entry.value: From the film, without leaving it

devices.label: Devices
devices.value: Tablet and computer, the film stays with you
